query:
SELECT max(created_at) AS "sent_at"
            FROM (
                SELECT created_at
                FROM comms_messages
                WHERE id = $1 AND sender_id = $2 AND created_at < $3
                UNION ALL
                SELECT created_at
                FROM comms_messages
                WHERE thread_id = $1 AND sender_id = $2 AND created_at < $3
                  AND deleted_at IS NULL
            ) request
